data.narrative:
Naïfo Technologies is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised €54.7M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public (277810.KQ) and 8 private entities in the robotics and manufacturing sector at the same or adjacent funding stages, including Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Hadrian.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline, applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C-to-next-stage progression, implying a valuation of $93M. Peer-median analysis benchmarks Naïfo against seven same-sector comparables spanning Series B through Series D, which carry a median valuation of $1.6B with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B. This dispersion reflects substantial variance in stage and commercial traction within the cohort.

The triangulated valuation range is $79M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $871M. The wide spread reflects tension between early-stage capital deployment metrics and late-stage peer valuations. Key uncertainties include Naïfo's revenue maturity and growth rate relative to peers, which the peer set does not fully isolate, and whether late-stage comparables (Exotec, Hadrian at Series D) appropriately anchor a Series C entity. Stage-progression and peer-median methods support materially different conclusions, suggesting that resolution of commercial performance data would be necessary to narrow the range.
